coverageNotes: Tests the native Query async-iteration interface. Promise orchestration and dashboard business logic are supplied; physical backend parallelism and performance are not assessed.

questions.concept: Consume a native Convex Query incrementally
questions.question: Which loop reads the native Convex query incrementally, allowing reaction reads to start as posts arrive?

options.rationale: Incorrect: a native Convex Query is asynchronously iterable, not synchronously iterable; ordinary for-of cannot consume it.
Correct: native Convex queries implement the async-iteration interface. for-await yields each post to the supplied body without first materializing an array.
Incorrect: the native Convex Query has no stream() method. The query itself implements async iteration.
Incorrect: take(15) resolves to an array only after fetching its posts. No reaction query starts until that array has been fetched.
